summary: Normalized spaced dash variants in source-title translation keys so resumed 2026-08-03 intake reuses an approved translation and passes source-title integrity.
issues: The captured source title used an em dash while the approved translation used a hyphen
producing raw_title_invalid at the pre-commit gate.
risks: Only spaced separator dashes are normalized to avoid collapsing hyphens inside words.
lessons: Normalize publisher separators before translation cache lookup.
reusable_rules: and em dash as the same source-title translation-key separator.
